about_the_game:
Core Experience

Master the art of precision combat in this action strategy game where split-second decisions determine your destiny.
 
Time the pickup of color changing power-ups to gain complimentary fusions that = a Synergy Strike ability!

 
Chain strike attacks to build powerful combos while navigating through a liminal landscape of danger and beauty.

 
Unlock new Powers, audio mix tapes, and trail tails by gaining a huge score bank, combo, or completing an objective.

🎮 Try the free demo now to experience the core Synergy Strike gameplay!

Key Features

🔸 4-Player Co-Op Team Experience

Revive your fallen buddies by defeating a powerful boss

Earn the ultimate high score together on the same screen

Discover why group synergy makes all the difference

🔸 Hypnotic Combat System

Fluid, responsive controls that feel natural from the first moment

Progressive combo system rewarding skillful play with up to 10x score multipliers

Strategic dash mechanics that transform simple inputs into complex battle choreography

🔸 Competitive Edge

Global leaderboards to prove your mastery

Challenge the high score in single and team modes to test your skill

Go on a thrilling journey towards unlocking your potential

Perfect For

Arcade enthusiasts seeking their next addiction

Score-chasers hungry for leaderboard dominance

Players looking for quick, intense gaming sessions

Competitive gamers ready for online versus battles

Achievement hunters wanting comprehensive progression systems

Technical Details

Endless Replay-Ability with Expanded Content

Supports Keyboard, Gamepad, Steam-Deck Touch

HDR Support, Aspect Ratios From 1:1 To Ultra-Wide

Steam Cloud Saves & Full Steam Integration

Enhanced Online Multiplayer Systems

Controls

Arrow Keys / Gamepad Controller: Navigate the arena with fluid precision

Space Bar / South Controller Button: Execute devastating dash strike attacks

"B"/ North Controller Button: Activate power-up Slot 1 ability

ESC Key / Pause: Freeze time and take a moment of respite

⚡Surge into the complete Synergy Strike experience where every run is a chance to achieve valor, every combo builds your legend, and every play session pulls you deeper into a world of geometric action.

*The Full Game expands this experience with: LOTS MORE POWER UPS & SYNERGY STRIKE ABILITIES

🔸 Massive Content Expansion

Increased multitude of elemental power ups and synergy combinations

Unlock 30+ tail trail customizations

Unlock 20+ mix tape music tracks with full "Play Next" system

+15 additional enemy types for diverse combat encounters

+5 elite enemy variants that will test your mastery

+8 additional boss battles with unique mechanics

100+ Expanded background art variety for visual richness

🔸 Enhanced Multiplayer Systems

All arcade team modes from demo PLUS new group party 3 or 4 player Co-Op modes

🔸 Steam Integration & Achievements

Full Steam achievements system with progression tracking

Enhanced Steam leaderboards and stat tracking

Steam Cloud saves for cross-device progression

*Features and content described above represent the current development roadmap and may be subject to change during final stages of development.

🎯 Experience the core gameplay now with a free demo, then prepare for the ultimate version coming soon!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or SteamOS 3 (64-bit)
  • Processor: : Intel Core i5-2400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (proprietary driver 535+), AMD Radeon RX 470 (Mesa 23+), or Intel Arc A380; Vulkan-capable GPU with 2–4 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan; tested on Proton 9+ where applicable.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or SteamOS 3 (latest)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (6 cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX 2060, AMD RX 5600 XT / RX 6600, or better; Vulkan-capable GPU with 6–8 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Targets 4K HDR on High settings; Proton 9+ recommended.

short_description: Flow into focus as power-ups fuse into Synergy Strikes that shatter swarms and boost scores. Chase combos, climb leaderboards, and unlock hypnotic audio reactive visuals that pulse with every beat. Collect tantalizing tails while vibing and gain a hefty score bank to level up your abilities.
